ruleset.name: RCS HRMS
ruleset.description:
PSR-12 coding standard for the HRMS PHP application.
Use locally (install PHP_CodeSniffer however you prefer — this repo has no composer.json; CI pins 4.0.4): phpcs (whole app — reports a lot: the existing code predates this standard) phpcs path/to/file (a single file) phpcbf path/to/file (fix what can be fixed mechanically)
CI (.github/workflows/php-lint.yml) runs this against only the PHP files a push changed, as a non-blocking report: PHP_CodeSniffer has no baseline feature, so gating on PSR-12 today would fail every push. The blocking PHP gate is PHPStan (level 4 + phpstan-baseline.neon) plus the Generic.PHP.ForbiddenFunctions / Squiz.PHP.Eval sniffs.
